note: Hand-curated decode of the 0xF0 configuration/provisioning worker 0xa39a and its 7-entry sub-dispatch. Offsets are payload offsets (image base 0). Confidence: Confirmed (from disassembly) unless marked Correlated.

dispatch.selector: payload[0] (first byte after the validated header), range 1..7
dispatch.stored_handle: 0xa39e: sh a0 -> RAM (16-bit request/handle latched before dispatch)

shared_primitives.0x8a54: config-store commit/flush: walks a config object (state base ~0x1fffbfec, slot 8), invokes resident slot 0x4000017c then 0x40000068 (NVS/flash-backed bond or settings persist).
shared_primitives.0x8f46: send 4-byte ack/result via resident notify slot 0x40000050 (a1=4, status byte from 0x...a0).
shared_primitives.0x8dec: long config/bond builder: allocates via resident slot 0x40000070, populates a multi-field record (large stack frame, many callee-saved regs).
shared_primitives.0x40000040: resident 6-byte compare (BLE MAC memcmp) used during bond-table scans.

sub_handlers.summary: Commit current config and set enabled flag. Calls 0x8a54 (config commit), then writes 1 to a RAM enable byte and returns.
Reset/clear two config bytes then rebuild and notify. Calls 0x8a54, zeroes two RAM config bytes, then 0x8f46 (4-byte ack).
No-op / epilogue: restores callee-saved registers and returns (shared function tail). Selector 3 and 6 both land here, i.e. reserved/unused subcodes.
Tail-call into config builder 0x8dec after epilogue (apply a new config record).

Bond-table operation gated on selector-arg == 0x1F. Clears a RAM byte, then iterates the connection/bond array at gp+0x7c (stride 0x2B = 43 bytes, up to index 0x81) comparing 6-byte MAC addresses via resident slot 0x40000040.
evidence: 0xa45c..0xa474: lw slot; resident 6-byte memcmp (slot 0x40); stride 0x2B; limit 0x81

sub_handlers.summary: Second bond-table operation gated on selector-arg == 7. Advances the payload pointer by 2, clears a RAM byte, then iterates the gp+0x7c bond array (stride/limit as selector 5) — pair/unpair a specific peer.

bond_table.note: Correlated: this is the paired-peer/bond record array managed by F0 subcodes 5 and 7 and read during HID name binding (section 10).
